items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And now we get on to the Happy Black Aces. Do you remember them? Gene Colley's band? Gene Colley. Colley, C-O-Y. Gene Colley. No? No. That may not have ever been a big name. [INTERVIEWEE] No, it could have been.

ctx.x: Well, the old vocalions, that was the first one. And then it went into the OKEH, which just said OKRUNS. Well, because that's the one that Troy made the Chattanoid blues on and also Dreamland.
And now we get on to the Happy Black Aces. Do you remember them? Gene Colley's band? Gene Colley. Colley, C-O-Y. Gene Colley. No? No. That may not have ever been a big name.
